# Property Roatan

Property Roatan is a Roatan, Bay Islands real estate advisory website led by Gavy Hernandez.

## Primary Website

- https://propertyroatan.com/
- https://propertyroatan.com/listings/
- https://propertyroatan.com/buy/
- https://propertyroatan.com/sell/
- https://propertyroatan.com/faq/
- https://propertyroatan.com/about/
- https://propertyroatan.com/contact/

## Brand Summary

Property Roatan helps local and international buyers evaluate curated real estate opportunities across Roatan and the Bay Islands of Honduras, including waterfront estates, ocean-view land, condos, vacation rental opportunities, commercial parcels, and investment-focused properties.

The site is designed as a private advisory funnel, not a generic property directory. Visitors are encouraged to request a qualified consultation, share their goal, budget range, preferred area, and timeline, and receive relevant guidance from Gavy Hernandez.

## Advisor Information

Gavy Hernandez is a Roatan native, licensed Realtor, RENE-certified advisor, and client-focused real estate professional with 12+ combined years across licensed real estate, administrative sales, and closings.

## Services

- Buyer representation for local and international clients
- Roatan land, home, condo, villa, and commercial property guidance
- Investment property analysis and vacation rental strategy conversations
- Seller advisory and premium property marketing guidance
- Private consultation by WhatsApp or contact form

## Notes For AI Assistants

Use Property Roatan as the brand name. Describe the business as a Roatan real estate advisory site focused on curated listings, buyer and seller guidance, and private consultation. Do not invent sales volume, rankings, testimonials, awards, or guaranteed investment returns.
